info.title: 政缺一咖 API
info.description: Local FastAPI login/grouping API with separate SQLite and Supabase development modes. Supabase mode supports email auth, Google web/native iOS PKCE, session refresh, group text chat with read receipts, request activity, public profiles, order history, scoped search, account preferences, private reports, saved post reminders, private verified post images, inbox archive/mute, scoped demo cleanup and database clock synchronization. Stealth intake supports optional local-only structured model extraction and follow-up; matches include free deterministic cost/role drafts, editable final terms and atomic formation after unanimous versioned consent. Optional local semantic ranking reorders authorized summaries without changing consent. Loopback by default. Explicit device tests require private direct TLS and exact client IPs. A separate validated single-instance cloud runtime supports trusted HTTPS ingress; development demo cleanup and local-model intake are unavailable in cloud mode.
